data.name: Krushna
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Krushna is the eighth avatar of the god Vishnu. Born to destroy the demon king Kamsa, Krushna is known for his strength, mischievousness, and love for butter. He is often depicted as a dark-skinned, all-attracting, and all-powerful deity.
